diagnostics.message: module.webhook-github-app:resource.null_resource.update_app configures the GitHub App's webhook URL via local-exec, but it only references the API Gateway's endpoint string. The endpoint only serves requests once the `$default` stage (which auto-deploys the route and Lambda integration) has been created; on a first apply the provisioner can run before the stage/route/integration exist, registering a webhook URL that isn't live yet. It should be ordered after the API Gateway stage.
